assertion_analysis.fails_if: The initial ledger-backed refresh omits fixture rows; 50 is fixed by the fixture, not passed to refresh as an expected result.

Removing either stamp or date comparison admits the deliberately truncated 25-row samples; expected was captured from the complete 50-row ledger before damaging the sidecar and was never supplied as input to the second refresh.

Publishing a truncated or otherwise incorrect rebuilt profile changes the independently read disk value; removing the cache write alone can retain the previous good value, so this assertion is specifically a wrong-publication check.

Taking the fold branch passes rows= to the wrapped builder instead of requesting a ledger-backed build, or skips/repeats the build; PROJECT and NOW check forwarding, while the absence of rows= is the independent branch discriminator.
